Looking at panel A, Cluster 14 is shown with three markers: ALDH1A1 (Schwann progenitor cells), ISL1 (cardiac neural crest cells), and STMN2 (cardiac neural crest cells). Both ISL1 and STMN2 label the same cardiac neural crest cell population in Cluster 14, and their expression plots (violin plots peaking at cluster 14) overlap.

In panel D, ISL1 marks the cardiac neural crest cells within the outflow tract (OFT). Since STMN2 marks the identical cardiac neural crest cell population (Cluster 14), substituting STMN2 for ISL1 would reproduce the same spatial pattern in the OFT.

The other options (ITLN1, TBX18, TCF21) mark epicardial/epicardium‑derived cells (panel B), and ALDH1A1 marks Schwann progenitors (shown as the distinct green population in D), so they would not replicate the ISL1 signal.

[ANSWER]G[/ANSWER]
